observations: A white game console wrapped in plastic film.
A black game controller wrapped in plastic film.
A yellow sticker on the console reads 'PS4' and 'Japan'.
The console is resting on a marble-patterned surface.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI SHOW GAMES' is visible across the image.

claims.evidence: The console is wrapped in plastic film, which obscures the condition of the ports and buttons.
Only the console and one controller are shown; other accessories like the power cable, HDMI cable, and charging cable are not visible.
No games are visible in the photos.

risks.risk: The console may be a refurbished or 'grey market' unit rather than a genuine Japan import.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the firmware version and region code.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty optical disc drive.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and a disc being read.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the menu.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the region and firmware.
Photo of the power cable and HDMI cable.
Video of the console powering on and reading a disc.
Video of the controller being used.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
